sn2.10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena suriyo devaputto rāhunā asurindena gahito hoti.
sn2.10:1.3: atha kho suriyo devaputto bhagavantaṃ anussaramāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
sn2.10:3.1: atha kho bhagavā suriyaṃ devaputtaṃ ārabbha rāhuṃ asurindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn2.10:5.3: yo andhakāre tamasī pabhaṅkaro verocano maṇḍali uggatejo mā rāhu gilī caramantalikkhe
sn2.10:6.1: atha kho rāhu asurindo suriyaṃ devaputtaṃ muñcitvā taramānarūpo yena vepacitti asurindo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
sn2.10:6.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho rāhuṃ asurindaṃ vepacitti asurindo gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
